verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.28 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.31 to +0.06). Of 60 untouched cells given the same test, 0 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.02). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out
